from typing import Literal
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentClassification(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document's classification result."""
    title: str = Field(description="The full title of the judgment document")
    cause_of_action: Literal['海事海商纠纷', '执行案由-行政非诉执行', '行政主体-房屋拆迁管理（拆迁）', '刑事赔偿', '行政主体-劳动和社会保障行政管理（劳动，社会保障）'] | None = Field(description="The specific cause of action category the document belongs to, or None if it does not match any target category")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    document_classifications: list[DocumentClassification]
